product.name: Apple 60W MagSafe 1 Charger
product.full_name: Genuine 60W MagSafe Power Adapter for MacBook Pro 13" / MacBook
product.description: Genuine Apple power adapter (Model A1344, Apple Part No. MC461LL/A) for the 13-inch MacBook Pro (2009 to 2012) and 13-inch MacBook (2009 to 2010) with the original MagSafe (MagSafe 1) magnetic connector. 16.5V, 3.65A, 60W output. Not suitable for the 15-inch and 17-inch MacBook Pro, which need the 85W adapter, and not compatible with the thinner MagSafe 2 connector used on Retina MacBook Pro and MacBook Air models from 2012 onward. Includes the detachable AC wall plug. Wide-range 100–240V AC input for worldwide use. Original Apple unit, tested before dispatch.

delivery_note: Same-day delivery in Nairobi · 1–2 days upcountry
